prompt_used: You simplify complex texts by rewriting them in Plain English. Use clear, descriptive and explanatory language. Your simplification can be longer than the source text if making it longer makes it easier to comprehend.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in the study of the brain because they are easy to manage and help scientists learn about how the brain works. For a long time, researchers have preferred to use male mice in their experiments. One reason for this preference is that female mice go through a hormone cycle, which can make their behavior change. Scientists worry that these changes might affect the results of their studies.
